content.title: Отправь свои планы
content.task: Сейчас: библиотека. Следующее место: школа. Место встречи: школа. Напиши Нине короткое сообщение: где ты сейчас, куда идёшь и где вы встретитесь.
content.task_en: You are in the library and are going to school. Tell Nina where you are, where you are going and that you will meet at school.
content.model_answer: Я сейчас в библиотеке. Иду в школу. Встретимся в школе.
content.model_answer_en: An example is available only on request; opening it marks the response as supported.

criteria.expectation: Communicate the current place intelligibly. Accept short natural replies.
Communicate the destination intelligibly. Accept short natural replies.
Communicate where the friend should meet the writer. Accept a natural meeting phrase; no greeting or word minimum is required.
Assess the attempted location form with в or на. Leave a valid alternative construction unobserved; communication is scored separately.
